entries.e20776ec382fd63e: On the occasion of its transition to a holding company structure, the company formulated the group management guideline "Story: Innovating the Future." Its management vision is to remain a "company that is indispensable," supporting future industrial promotion and development, by redefining its "founding spirit" in line with changes in the times and society. The company sets out transformation into a "New Business Contractor" that creates new businesses beyond the framework of the construction industry, and in its "Medium-Term Management Plan (through fiscal 2027)" it will advance expansion of the earnings base, management conscious of the cost of capital, and strengthening of governance.
